description: Get the user's day in one call: their plan for the date (with the version set_day_plan needs), conversations from the last 24 hours, and two lists of open commitments (not done, not waiting in Review, not a repeat). iOwe is only the user's own promises due by the date or with no date (with person, every one involving them, whatever its date); owedToMe is every promise someone made the user, whatever its date. Use it before planning or changing the user's day; for what the user owes this week or over any range, call list_tasks with dateField due and from/to. For what is owed, either way: get_my_day is one day (the user's promises due by it or undated, and every promise owed to them), list_tasks is every open commitment over any date range or person, and get_recent_commitments is what the last 7 days of meetings promised.

date.description: Optional: the user's local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out for the user's today in their Fluent time zone; the result names the date and zone used.

person.description: Optional: a person's name. iOwe and owedToMe then list every open promise involving someone whose name contains it (case-insensitive) as the other person, in the task or in its conversation's title, whatever its due date. The plan and recent conversations stay the whole day's.

personId.description: Optional, with person: that person's id from list_people. A task linked to a person then counts only when it is linked to them; a task with no link falls back to the name.

name: get_my_day
